messages:
Mia Chen: heads-up, converted hf/railway-llama in staging and got degraded chat outputs; tokenizer.json is missing so runtime used slow loader and lost our chat_template placeholders
Raj Patel: ouch. any logs?
Mia Chen: pasted snippet from the serving instance:
```
W TokenLoader: tokenizer.json not found at /models/railway-llama/ -> falling back to slow_tokenizer_loader
I Loaded tokenizer via slow loader (v2)
E special_tokens_map.json present but special tokens order differs -> decoding fallback to <unk> for <pad>/<s>/<eos>
```
Olga Smirnova: looks like the repo only had slow-style artifacts (vocab.json + merges.txt) and tokenizer_config.json; our hf-to-redwood converter should have emitted tokenizer.json but it didn't
Sam Wells: do we know if convert step had the `--merge-subtokenizers` option turned on? if source had multiple tokenizer fragments it might skip producing a consolidated tokenizer.json
Mia Chen: i dug into the model dir: there is a `tokenizer_config.json` and `special_tokens_map.json`, plus a `tokenizer/` subdir with `vocab.json` and `merges.txt`. No `tokenizer.json` file at repo root.
Raj Patel: that matches the chat-template regression we saw. slow loader doesn't honor the custom `added_tokens` ordering or placeholders so prompts get reshuffled
model-checker-bot: [auto] scanner: missing tokenizer.json at /models/railway-llama (severity=warning)
Olga Smirnova: proposed short-term fix: add a synth step in our hf-to-redwood toolchain that, when tokenizer.json is absent but slow artifacts exist, synthesizes a tokenizers-compatible tokenizer.json by merging vocab+merges and preserving `special_tokens_map.json` order
Sam Wells: agreed. also add a hard fail in the conversion CI for any model where `special_tokens_map.json` exists but `tokenizer.json` is missing — at least for initial onboarding runs
Mia Chen: prototype command I ran to confirm absence:
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; Tokenizer.from_file('models/railway-llama/tokenizer.json')"
```
-> FileNotFoundError
Mia Chen: i'll write `tools/hf_convert/synth-tokenizer.py` to synthesize tokenizer.json (vocab.json + merges -> tokenizers BPE model) and include a small wrapper `synth-tokenizer.sh` with usage notes
Olga Smirnova: when synthesizing, keep the order of `added_tokens` exactly as in special_tokens_map.json — we previously saw decode diffs when order changed
Raj Patel: add an integration test: convert the public railway-llama pack, run `evals/chat-template-decode` and assert special token roundtrip equality. Fail the PR if mismatch
Sam Wells: also update conversion image tag (convert:v2026-03-20) in CI after landing, and bump the `hf-convert` package version in the onboarding docs
infra-bot: note: if synth script added, tag converter and rebuild conversion image before running conversions in CI (action=required)
Mia Chen: will open PR with synth script + failing integ test + the log snippet above. assigning to myself for initial patch, pinging @Raj Patel and @Olga Smirnova for review. PR will include: repro instructions, failing example, and a note to run `synth-tokenizer.sh` when converter skips tokenizer.json
Raj Patel: thanks. once PR lands let's re-run the conversion job for that model and confirm chat-template evauation passes
Mia Chen: timeline: aiming for PR today, CI run tomorrow. will post updates here. :thumbsup:
